evidence.claim: The SEC-hosted Q1 2026 results exhibit reports Energy Storage price growth of 51%, volume growth of 14%, sales growth of 70%, and adjusted EBITDA growth of 196%. Group operating cash flow was USD 346 million and company-defined free cash flow was USD 248 million, demonstrating direct lithium-price and volume transmission with cash conversion.

The current security review records high commodity sensitivity, 40% of salts volume under long-term agreements, improved cash conversion and leverage, and an ineligible valuation_unsupported assessment because no probability-weighted downside and base common-equity values are supportable.

The maintained idea defines the causal channel from EV and storage demand plus delayed supply to producer realized prices and margins, while preserving restarts, new projects, recycling, sodium-ion chemistry, capital intensity, contract lags, and dilution as contrary evidence.
